answer: Anchor each identity to one verified academic degree: the agent binds its degree number and transcript hash to its key for a registry check. One degree backs one identity; duplicates rejected, weight only after confirmation. A fake costs one four-year degree: about 24,000 units tuition plus four years of study, so 100 fakes cost 2,400,000 units and 400 student-years, and no tide of money shortens those four years. Diploma-mill degrees fail like a marble statue with no quarry record; a bought degree costs the seller their own weight; a stolen number collides with its holder and burns the fake.
